command: import json,time; import scripts.evaluate_point_context_oof_graph_gate as gate; prepare=json.load(open('reports/g02/selected_graph_temporal_background_prepare_v1/prepare.json')); contract=gate.load_contract(gate.DEFAULT_CONTRACT,gate.DEFAULT_CONTRACT_SHA256); eligible=tuple(sorted(v['identity'] for v in prepare['videos'] if v['partition']=='train' and v['identity'].split(':',1)[1].startswith('6bba_'))); fit_ids=gate.nested_partitions(eligible,5)[0][0]; windows,edges=gate._load_partition_windows(prepare,cache_root=gate.DEFAULT_CACHE,identities=fit_ids); cfg={**contract['candidate']['architecture'],**contract['candidate']['optimization']}; model,mean,scale,record=gate._train(windows,cfg,seed=cfg['seed_base']); print(json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True),flush=True); time.sleep(10)
